differences.what: Cross-cutting, cited not re-described. B1-01/B2-01 (no white topbar) and B1-04/B2-36 (rail 'Not available yet' on Assets/Settings): every pair. B1-07/B2-03 (14 px panel sentences vs mock 12 px): cold Overview (7 paragraphs: timeline sentence, money lines, Next step), cold-evidence-analysis 'How a claim limit is set', cold-financials 'Not included' bullets. B1-02/B2-04 (tall dark 390 header on short pages): cold-evidence-analysis no-selection 390 (136 px) and refused 390 (241 px), cold-assumptions refused 390 (231 px); all other 390 pairs 92 px. B2-21/B3-04 (UTC not site-local): every Selected-window line, timeline times, 'Contact checked at window end', Analysis Sent/Received (UTC) beside Measured (EAT). B1-53 (system vocabulary): cold-assumptions subtitle 'no cold assumption publication is available in W2'; Analysis values '3.8 degC'/'20 degC' and 'REC 00000002-0000-4000-8000-0000000000b6'; cold-findings 'file-backed comparison must run', 'As of: time not recorded'. B3-13 analogue on cold-findings (lens chips 'Not available yet', no 'Manage in Findings'); B3-15 analogue on cold-financials (strip lacks 'Portfolio roll-up'). B4-03/B4-04/B5-01 do not recur (no Action screen; no extra Site tab row - the only tab rows are the mock's Site row and the Evidence/Financials subtabs). B4-19 does not recur (no event-kind fall-through or duplicate key; no console errors on any pair). Carried checks not applicable here: '1 incidents' plural, raw 'c1 · EV_CONNECTOR'.
differences.disp: Cite existing batch IDs; shared fix owner is the shell/typography seam (B1-53 copy items go to the W2 cold fix slice).

differences.what: HIGH. /sites/COLD-LAB-001/findings renders the mini-grid dispatch Findings index for the cold Site: strip 'Findings list closed for this Site / Not released for this Site / This Site's assessments are not released, so no Findings list can be shown. It is not empty. / Mini-grid dispatch Findings at this site', body 'No Performance comparison report exists for this Site; the file-backed comparison must run', 0 rows, in every case (stocked, no-selection, refused, no-window, normal). The cold Findings exist and are current: GET /api/sites/COLD-LAB-001/cold/findings for the stocked window returns CURRENT with assessment revisions ...016d/...0173, and the cold Overview links 'Open Finding' to them. App.tsx mounts SITE_FINDINGS_ROUTE_PATH -> SiteFindingsFrame without coldDepth/coldAssessment. Mock: lens chips, 'Scoped to GreenHarvest · 2 open' strip with Manage in Findings, 7-column table with 2 cold Findings, footer note. Spec route-table error: the spec names W2-03 as owner, but W2-owner-walkthrough-index.md:112 says cold-findings was not built in W2, post-W2-sequence.md:18 moved it to W5-02, and W5-02-build-spec.md never builds it. No register row tracks it.
differences.disp: (c) D3: the page states a false reason (not released / no comparison report) for a Site whose Findings are released and readable; a cold Site Findings index over the existing cold findings API is renderable. W2 cold fix slice (new unit). Architect to correct the spec owner column.

differences.what: No window control at all on the W2 cold Site screens: the window is URL-only (from/to query); without it the read defaults to the latest window. Refused states (from > to) give no way to correct the window on the page. Mock: topbar 'Window: Event window 6 Oct 2026 · 19:00-20:00 EAT' picker. R88 says 'URL-only selection is unusable' and ruled a page-local Window control for cold Work only.
differences.disp: (a)/(b) extend R88 (D1, page-local Window control) to these five screens, or fold into the shared topbar fix behind B1-01.

differences.what: Metric cards: no 'View detail' links; the card label itself is a link for Temperature, Backup and Evidence (coldSiteViews.tsx:499). Cooling has no link although Performance > Cooling is built (W5-01a), and Maintenance is hard-coded 'Not recorded / ... / Work record not available' (coldSiteViews.tsx:512) although cold Work/Maintenance is built (W5-02b). Mock: five cards each with 'View detail'.
differences.disp: Cooling/Maintenance: (c) D3 - the R40 D5 expiry was resolved for Performance tabs but not for these Overview cards; link Cooling and read the selected maintenance cases or say why none. Label-as-link instead of 'View detail': (c) D3 Low.

differences.what: 'What happened' timeline: labels are role + observation ('Grid supply · Observed', 'Generator · Observed', 'Start result · Observed') with all-blue markers, where the mock states the event and tone ('Grid supply lost', 'Generator failed to start' red, 'Cooling running again' green) plus a source line. 'Generator · Observed' sits beside a failed start without saying it failed. Head 'No incident recorded' / 'Open Finding' vs 'Incident INC-203' / 'Open incident' (producer has no incident). Sentence 'The steps below are based on...' sits below the steps (W2 polish note, still present, coldSiteViews.tsx:600).
differences.disp: Event wording/tone: (c) D3 candidate if the causal_strip step result is on the wire (Architect to confirm), else D1. Incident: (b) D1 for this producer state. 'steps below': (c) D3 Low copy.

differences.what: Chamber temperature panel lacks the mock's 'Single line diagram' link (links 0/1) though cold SLD is built (W2-01); the EV Overview got this link in W2-F (M8) but cold did not. Needs attention: 2 items, no Action/Work codes, and both items repeat 'Not observed: transfer to backup.' as sub-text (item 1 is the start failure). Next step: Finding title + 'Open Finding' vs mock Action heading, description and 'Review action ACT-051' button.
differences.disp: SLD link: (c) D3 Low (route built; EV precedent M8). Repeated sub-text: (c) D3 Low copy. Action codes / Review action: (b) D1 for this producer state (no Action); Architect to confirm the Overview reads linked Actions when they exist.

differences.what: Status strip lacks the mock narrative 'Power -> backup -> cooling chain fully reconstructed · no spoilage determination'. Money panel adds 'Consequence basis: at least 19 °C·min; upper bound not established' (1.52x at 390: 288 vs 190 px).
differences.disp: Strip narrative: (b) D1 unless a selected source for chain completeness exists. Money 1.52x at 390: measured reason = the extra basis line (W2-F M6) - needs a reviewed ruling.

differences.what: Strip right link is 'Configuration at window end' where the mock has 'Portfolio evidence' (/evidence built in W3-02). Next step column is generic 'Review evidence'/'Review financials' on every row; mock has row-specific 'Raise action', 'Map transfer switch', 'Review cooling' (Cooling page now built). Data sources: Contact 'Unknown' on every source, titles 'Contact at window end'/'Accepted quality' vs 'Status at window end'/'Quality', subtitle differs, no device codes, adds 'Source details' disclosure (1.24x at 1440). 'What we can conclude now' 1.32-1.36x at 390 (long 'What is missing' sentences; table scrolls 820 px in 318 px, readable). Most useful next evidence: 2 items (excursion) and 'Next evidence not identified' in the normal case although Product exposure is None with a stated required basis on the same page.
differences.disp: Portfolio link: (c) D3 Low. Review cooling: (c) D3 (R40 destination built). Raise action / Map transfer switch: (b) D1. Contact Unknown / titles: (b) D1 + D2, register. Conclude 1.36x at 390: needs a reviewed ruling. Empty next-evidence while a basis is missing (normal): (c) D3 Low consistency defect.

differences.what: Accepted records: first 3 of 93 with 'Show all 93 accepted records' and a 'Record details' disclosure; Record cell 'REC {full UUID} / Record page unavailable' wraps to 3 lines (R38 closure verified: no unproved anchor). Received shows time only ('16:08:42', the 24 Oct replay time) beside Measured '22:00:00' EAT on 6 Oct with no date, so the late-arrival comparison is unreadable. Sample rows are window-start rows (ambient, grid) not the mock's claim-relevant records. Panel 1.47x at 1440, 1.31x at 390; 'How a claim limit is set' adds 'Claim details' (1.29x).
differences.disp: R38: verified closed. Record cell: R38 + B1-53. Received date omitted: (c) D3 Low. Height 1.47x: measured reason = 3-line record cells + show-all button + disclosure; needs a reviewed ruling.

differences.what: Close match. KPI label 'Chamber thermal exposure' vs 'Product exposure'; Source cells link Finding titles vs F-118/F-119; row 1 repeats the consequence basis; adds 'Basis details' disclosure; 'Review assumptions' is a text link vs button; 'Not included' 4 bullets at 14 px vs one 12 px paragraph: 1.87x at 390 (stocked, normal, no-window). M5 (2 lines = 2 rows) and M7 (same 3 assumption rows) verified closed; refused keeps strip + 4 tiles (M3).
differences.disp: F-code: (a) extend R65 (D1) to cold-financials. Not included 1.87x at 390: measured reason = 4 bullets + B1-07 type size; needs a reviewed ruling or collapse to the mock paragraph (D3 Low). Label / repeated basis: (b) D2 low or (c) D3 Low copy - Architect. Portfolio roll-up: cite B3-15.

differences.what: Close match (3 rows, same columns). Adds a Selected window line (mock none); the read is site-scoped yet an invalid window refuses the whole panel; subtitle carries 'in W2' (B1-53).
differences.disp: Window line / refusal on a site-scoped read: (b) D2 low or (c) D3 Low - Architect. Subtitle: B1-53.

differences.disp: (c) D3 Low copy under the carried UI-pass item; shared fix owner with domainActionClient.
